title: 蝙蝠为什么能在黑夜飞行
integrated: A cute little bat flying through a dark but beautiful moonlit cave. Vertical 9:16 composition. One continuous shot. 0–2 seconds: The bat flies smoothly between several hanging rocks in the darkness. 2–5 seconds: Show gentle glowing sound waves radiating from its mouth, bouncing off a small fruit ahead and returning to its large ears. The bat accurately changes direction and catches the fruit. Adorable 3D animation, magical blue lighting, scientifically inspired echolocation visualization.
soundscape: Soft cave ambience, gentle wing flaps, subtle echoing clicks.
dialogue: 蝙蝠会发出超声波，靠回声判断前方有没有东西！

title: 袋鼠为什么有育儿袋
integrated: A cute mother kangaroo standing in a sunny Australian grassland. A tiny baby kangaroo peeks out from her front pouch, then looks around curiously. The mother gently hops forward while the baby remains safely inside the pouch. Vertical 9:16 composition. One continuous shot. Beautiful warm sunlight, adorable high-quality 3D family animation.
soundscape: Soft natural sound effects matching the scene.
music: Cheerful, lighthearted children's science background music.
voice: Warm, lively, friendly children's science narrator.
dialogue: 小袋鼠出生时很小，会住在妈妈的育儿袋里长大！
